name: Pagination
summary: Controls that split a long list into pages with previous, next and page numbers.

anatomy.purpose: Hides far pages on long lists.

whenToUse: Large result sets people need to move through predictably.
whenNotToUse: Social feeds: use infinite scroll with a Load more button.

notes: Label arrows with text or aria-labels.
